inspiration.source_location: Minimized from Case Study #2 - Pizza Runner/1. MySQL code.sql:395-428
inspiration.observed_pattern: A derived source assigns a ROW_NUMBER ordinal before two JSON_TABLE expansions are joined.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored shipment row, two add-ons, and one restriction while retaining the derived wildcard projection, window ordinal, and dual JSON_TABLE joins that expose derived-column metadata.

fixture_notes: One fixed shipment has two add-ons and one restriction, producing two rows while the derived shipment ID remains an INT column in MariaDB metadata.
determinism_notes: One shipment ID, fixed JSON arrays, explicit window ordering, and ordered output; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_shipment_attribute_sets (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, shipment_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, add_ons JSON NOT NULL, restrictions JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT t.source_row, t.shipment_id, t.shipment_code, a.add_on, r.restriction FROM (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY shipment_id) AS source_row FROM mini_shipment_attribute_sets AS s) AS t INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(t.add_ons, '$[*]' COLUMNS (add_on VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) AS a INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(t.restrictions, '$[*]' COLUMNS (restriction VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) AS r ORDER BY t.source_row, a.add_on, r.restriction
